overview:
[Squid][1] is an open-source caching and forwarding web proxy server that operates as an intermediary between clients and servers on a network. It acts as a gateway, enabling clients to access various internet resources such as websites, files, and other content from servers.

This integration provides enrichment and visualization for Squid logs. It helps you visualize detailed insights into Squid log analysis through the out-of-the-box dashboards and detection rules, enhancing detection and response capabilities.

Additionally, it includes pre-configured monitors for proactive notifications on the following:

1. High rate of server errors
2. CPU usage exceeded
3. High latency requests
4. High rate of client HTTP errors


This check monitors [Squid][1] metrics from the Cache Manager through the Datadog Agent.

**Minimum Agent version:** 6.0.0

[1]: http://www.squid-cache.org/
setup:
### Installation

The Agent's Squid check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package. No additional installation is needed on your Squid server.

### Configuration

<!-- xxx tabs xxx -->
<!-- xxx tab "Host" xxx -->

#### Host

To configure this check for an Agent running on a host:

##### Metric collection

1. Edit the `squid.d/conf.yaml`, in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your [Agent's configuration directory][3]. See the [sample squid.d/conf.yaml][4] for all available configuration options.

2. [Restart the Agent][5].

##### Log collection

_Available for Agent versions >6.0_

1. Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent, enable it in your `datadog.yaml` file:

   ```yaml
   logs_enabled: true
   ```

2. Uncomment and edit this configuration block at the bottom of your `squid.d/conf.yaml` file:

   ```yaml
   logs:
     - type: file
       path: /var/log/squid/cache.log
       service: "<SERVICE-NAME>"
       source: squid
     - type: file
       path: /var/log/squid/access.log
       service: "<SERVICE-NAME>"
       source: squid
   ```

    Change the `path` and `service` parameter values and configure them for your environment.

3. [Restart the Agent][5].

<!-- xxz tab xxx -->
<!-- xxx tab "Containerized" xxx -->

#### Containerized

For containerized environments, see the [Autodiscovery Integration Templates][6] for guidance on applying the parameters below.

##### Metric collection

| Parameter            | Value                                                                  |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<INTEGRATION_NAME>` | `squid`                                                                |
| `<INIT_CONFIG>`      | blank or `{}`                                                          |
| `<INSTANCE_CONFIG>`  | `{"name": "<SQUID_INSTANCE_NAME>", "host": "%%host%%", "port":"3128"}` |

##### Log collection

_Available for Agent versions >6.0_

Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent. To enable it, see [Kubernetes Log Collection][7].

| Parameter      | Value                                               |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `<LOG_CONFIG>` | `{"source": "squid", "service": "<YOUR_APP_NAME>"}` |

<!-- xxz tab xxx -->
<!-- xxz tabs xxx -->

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][8] and look for `squid` under the Checks section.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.aborted_requests
metrics.description: The number of server-side HTTP requests aborted due to client-side aborts.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.kbytes_recv
metrics.description: The amount of traffic received from neighbors in Cache Digest messages.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.kbytes_sent
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent to neighbors in Cache Digest messages.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.local_memory
metrics.description: The amount of memory used to store Squid's own Cache Digest.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.memory
metrics.description: The amount of memory used by enabling the Cache Digests' feature.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.msgs_recv
metrics.description: The number of Cache Digest messages received from neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.msgs_sent
metrics.description: The number of Cache Digest messages sent to neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cd.times_used
metrics.description: The number of times Cache Digests resulted in the selection of a neighbor as the next-hop for a cache miss.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.errors
metrics.description: The number of client transactions that resulted in an error.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.hit_kbytes_out
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent to clients in responses that are cache hits

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.hits
metrics.description: The number of cache hits in response to client requests.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.kbytes_in
metrics.description: The amount of traffic received from clients in their requests.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.kbytes_out
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent to clients in responses.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.client_http.requests
metrics.description: The number of HTTP requests received from clients

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.cpu_time
metrics.description: The amount of CPU used by squid, as reported by getrusage( ).

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.kbytes_recv
metrics.description: The amount of traffic received in all ICP messages, including both queries and replies.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.kbytes_sent
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent in all ICP messages, including both queries and replies.

metrics.description: The number of ICP messages received from neighbors, including both queries and replies

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.pkts_sent
metrics.description: The number of ICP messages sent to neighbors. This includes both queries and replies but doesn't include HTCP messages.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.q_kbytes_recv
metrics.description: The amount of traffic received from neighbors in ICP queries.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.q_kbytes_sent
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent to neighbors in ICP queries.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.queries_recv
metrics.description: The number of ICP queries received from neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.queries_sent
metrics.description: The number of ICP queries sent to neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.query_timeouts
metrics.description: The number of times that Squid timed out waiting for ICP replies to arrive.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.r_kbytes_recv
metrics.description: The amount of traffic received from neighbors in ICP replies.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.r_kbytes_sent
metrics.description: The amount of traffic sent to neighbors in ICP replies.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.replies_queued
metrics.description: The number of times Squid queued an ICP message after the initial attempt to send failed.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.replies_recv
metrics.description: The number of ICP replies received from neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.replies_sent
metrics.description: The number of ICP replies sent to neighbors.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.icp.times_used
metrics.description: The number of times ICP resulted in the selection of a neighbor as the next-hop for a cache miss.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.page_faults
metrics.description: The number of (major) page faults as reported by getrusage( ).

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.select_loops
metrics.description: The number of times Squid called select( ) or poll( ) in the main I/O loop.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.all.errors
metrics.description: The number of server-side requests (all protocols) that resulted in some kind of error.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.all.kbytes_in

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.all.kbytes_out

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.all.requests

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.ftp.requests

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.http.errors

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.http.kbytes_in

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.http.kbytes_out
metrics.description: The amount of traffic written to HTTP origin servers and neighbor caches.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.http.requests
metrics.description: The number of server-side requests to HTTP servers, including neighbor caches.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.other.errors

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.other.kbytes_in

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.other.kbytes_out
metrics.description: The amount of traffic written to Gopher, WAIS, and SSL servers.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.server.other.requests
metrics.description: The number of "other" server-side requests. Currently, the other protocols are Gopher, WAIS, and SSL.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.swap.files_cleaned
metrics.description: The number of orphaned cache files removed by the periodic cleanup procedure.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.swap.ins
metrics.description: The number of objects (swap files) read from disk.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.swap.outs
metrics.description: The number of objects (swap files) saved to disk.

metrics.name: squid.cachemgr.unlink.requests
metrics.description: The number of unlink requests given to the (optional) unlinkd process.
